scope: Unify interval allocation and attributed region records into VirtualAddressPool; remove VirtualRegions and the separate kernel stack pool.
behavior: One free/live tree pair per kernel or process address space.
Fixed address zero reservations; bounded aligned automatic allocation; region containment and attributes from occupied nodes.
Atomic reserve/protect/partial erase preflight; exact release needs no allocation; candidate copy and swap.
Kernel stack guard and stack are attributed parts of one pool; stable published directory fault path remains unchanged.

contracts: 20000 random allocation/release operations against reference bitmap
40000 allocations, fragmentation, coalescing and metadata reclamation
12000 mixed attributed reserve/protect/erase/aligned allocation steps against a reference model
metadata OOM rollback, address-space lifecycle, demand paging and COW on both allocators

flow_coverage.caveat: Source/binding integrity is evidence of reviewed coverage, not proof of runtime semantics or every build profile.

additional_vm_tests.purpose: Explicit protect attribute-split OOM preserves original bounds and permissions on both allocators.

native_documentation.scope: 274 entries in changed memory/address-space/tree files plus 5 cross-module checks

limitations: No standalone fork timing or fork_progress tests run.
Attributed pool owns virtual interval metadata; page tables and data frames remain external.
Aligned bounded searches can inspect multiple candidate intervals; no universal O(log N) claim for arbitrary alignment/fragmentation.
No throughput or worst-case stack measurement.
